config: default and recommended; forward-auth sets X-Original-URI = ngx.var.request_uri (raw), proxies the normalised path upstream
observed: Kong reports the RAW target to the PDP (ALLOW, as RC1) but resolves the dot segments in the path it proxies upstream, so the executor receives a clean /api/v1/accounts/acc-bob-1 (or /api/v1/admin/users) -> forbidden op executed, status 200. Backend-independent (all 6 frameworks).
